411: they all had to leave behind.
They have become like a dream.
Only they are saved who have taken the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
Those who forsake the Lord and attach themselves to others
flee in the cycle of birth and death.
Those humble beings who have found the Lord, Har, Har,
One upon whom the Lord is merciful —
O Nanak, he is the Lord's devotee. ॥2॥7॥163॥232॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਉ; ਕਉਨ ਸਿਉ. ਮਨ ਕੀ ॥
Unto whom should I tell the condition of my mind?
ਲੋਭਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਦਸ ਹੂ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ; ਆਸਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਧਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Seized by greed, it runs around in the ten directions, clinging to its hope for wealth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੁਖ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਤ; ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ. ਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
For the sake of pleasure, it suffers so much pain, serving each and every person.
ਦੁਆਰਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ. ਸੁਆਨ ਜਿਉ ਡੋਲਤ; ਨਹ ਸੁਧ. ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
It wanders like a dog from door to door, unaware of the Lord's meditation. ॥1॥
ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ. ਅਕਾਰਥ ਖੋਵਤ; ਲਾਜ ਨ. ਲੋਕ ਹਸਨ ਕੀ ॥
It loses this human life in vain, and is not even ashamed when people laugh at it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ. ਕਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਤ; ਕੁਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਤਨ ਕੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੩੩॥
O Nanak, why not sing the Praises of the Lord, so that the evil-mindedness of the body may be dispelled? ॥2॥1॥233॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Coming down from the treacherous pass of ego, one bathes in the pool of the True Congregation.
ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Without talking or babbling, he sings the glorious praises of the Lord.
Like water evaporating into the sky, he merges into the Lord's state of absolute stillness.
ਰਸੁ ਸਤੁ ਝੋਲਿ; ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Churning the essence of truth, he obtains the supreme sublime essence. ॥1॥
Listen to such spiritual wisdom, O my mind:
ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸਭ ਠਉਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Lord is fully pervading and supporting all places. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਚੁ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ; ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥
One who makes the True Lord his fasts and religious vows is not tormented by death.
Through the Word of the True Guru, he burns away his anger.
He dwells in the heavens of the higher state of the soul, absorbed in deep meditation.
Touching the philosopher's stone, the Guru, he obtains the supreme status. ॥2॥
To control the mind, he churns the essence of the True Lord.
Bathing in the overflowing pool of nectar, where there is no filth, he is washed clean.
He becomes like the One with whom he is imbued.
Whatever the Creator Himself does comes to pass. ॥3॥
The Guru is cool and soothing like ice; He puts out the fire of desire.
Smear your body with the ashes of dedicated service,
and let your sect be to dwell in the home of intuitive poise.
Let the Immaculate Bani be your playing of the flute. ॥4॥
Spiritual wisdom within is the supreme, sublime essence.
Contemplation of the Guru is the cleansing bath at sacred shrines.
Worship within, where the Lord dwells,
and you shall merge your light into the Divine Light. ॥5॥
One whose intellect is delighted with the sublime essence of loving the One Lord
dwells on the throne within, having subdued the five passions.
Living by the Will of the Lord and Master is his work and his earning;
he becomes like the unmanifest Master, who cannot be described. ॥6॥
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ; ਜਲ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
The reflection of the moon appears in the water, yet the moon is far from the water.
So the Lord's light is in the water, and He is pervading everywhere.
To whom is He near, and from whom is He far away?
I sing the glorious praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, beholding Him ever-present. ॥7॥
Inwardly and outwardly, there is no other than Him.
412: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Whatever pleases Him comes to pass.
Listen, O Bharthari Yogi: Nanak speaks after deliberation:
the Immaculate Name is my only support. ॥8॥1॥
ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ; ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
One may practise all meditation, all penance and all cleverness,
but he wanders in the wilderness and does not find the path.
ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ; ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Without understanding, none of it is accepted.
Without the Name, ashes fall on one's head. ॥1॥
True is the Lord and Master; the world comes and goes.
That mortal is released, who becomes the slave of the Lord as Gurmukh. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The world is bound by attachment and by so many desires.
Through the Guru's teaching, some become detached.
The Name is within them, and their heart-lotus blossoms forth.
ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
They have no fear of death. ॥2॥
The world is conquered by lust and attached to women.
Attached to children and spouse, it forgets the Name.
It wastes this human life in vain, and loses the game.
One who serves the True Guru does the most excellent deed. ॥3॥
Outwardly he may speak and act in ego,
ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ; ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
but inwardly he is liberated, and never stained.
He burns away attachment to Maya through the Word of the Guru,
and meditates forever on the Immaculate Name within his heart. ॥4॥
He restrains his wandering mind and holds it in check.
Such a Sikh is united, by the Lord's grace, with the Congregation.
Without the Guru, the mortal goes astray, and continues coming and going.
When the Lord bestows His glance of grace, He unites him in union with Himself. ॥5॥
I try to describe how beautiful You are, Lord, but it cannot be described.
I try to speak of the unspoken, but Your worth cannot be estimated.
All sufferings are Yours, Lord; by Your Will, they become peace.
All pains are erased through the True Name. ॥6॥
ਕਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਾਜਾ; ਪਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
He plays the instrument without hands, and keeps the beat without feet,
ਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝੈ; ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
when he understands the Word; then he beholds the True Lord.
With the True Lord within, all peace is with him.
Bestowing His glance of grace, the Saviour Lord protects him. ॥7॥
He sees the Lord in the three worlds, when he sheds his self-conceit.
He understands the Bani of the Word, and is absorbed in the True Lord.
Contemplating the Word, he is lovingly attuned to the One Lord, and is carried across.
O Nanak, blessed is the one who embellishes the lives of others. ॥8॥2॥
Countless writings are written, and the writers take pride in them.
When the mind accepts the Lord, and the True Lord is in one's consciousness, that is the true description.
Speaking and talking, and reading and reading, only add to the burden.
There may be countless writings, but the Lord is beyond writing, infinite. ॥1॥
Know that such a True One is the One Lord alone.
Understand that birth and death come by the Command of His Will. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through attachment to Maya, the world is bound by the messenger of death.
The bound are released by contemplating the Name.
The Guru is the Giver of peace; do not look for any other.
Here and hereafter, He shall stay with you. ॥2॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਤਾਂ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
One who dies in the Word becomes lovingly attuned to the One Lord.
One who subdues the unconquerable passions eradicates his doubt.
He is liberated while yet alive, and the Name abides in his mind.
Becoming Gurmukh, he merges in the True Lord. ॥3॥
The One who created the earth and the heavens,
who established all, and who establishes and disestablishes,
He does not consult anyone; He Himself forgives. ॥4॥
You are the ocean, full of gems and jewels.
You are immaculate and true, the treasure of virtue, profound.
413: One who meets the Guru, the Spiritual Guide, finds peace.
You are the One Lord and Master, and You are Your own minister. ॥5॥
The world is in the prison of ego; only those who conquer their ego are liberated.
How rare in this world is the spiritual teacher who practises what he knows.
How rare in this world is the Pandit who truly contemplates.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ; ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Without meeting the True Guru, all wander around in ego. ॥6॥
The world is unhappy; only a rare few are happy.
The world is diseased with its indulgences, and weeps for lost virtue.
The world is born and dies, having lost its honour.
One who becomes Gurmukh understands this. ॥7॥
His price is so high, and His weight unbearable.
He is unchanging and undeceivable; through the Guru's teaching, enshrine Him in your heart.
He is met through love, and is pleased by the fear of Him.
When one dies, the relatives gather together and weep.
But those who wash away their filth through the Word are rid of their ego.
Understanding and realising, they dwell in the home of intuitive poise.
Without this understanding, all lose their honour. ॥1॥
Who dies, and who weeps over him?
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ; ਸਭਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, Creator and Cause of causes, You are over the heads of all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who weeps for the dead is really weeping over his own pain.
He alone weeps who is afflicted by suffering.
The one to whom it happens knows it to be God's Will;
whatever the Creator does comes to pass. ॥2॥
To remain dead while yet alive is the boat that carries one across.
Victory to the Lord of the Universe! In His sanctuary is the supreme state.
I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru.
The Guru is the boat; through the Word, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed. ॥3॥
He Himself is fearless; His light is within all.
Without the Name, the world is stained by the superstitions of impurity and untouchability.
Through evil-mindedness the world is ruined; why weep and wail over it?
Without devotion and without listening to His praises, people are born only to die. ॥4॥
Only one's former friends truly weep for one who has died to the self;
the three qualities of Maya weep for him continually,
for he has cast off pain and pleasure, and is aware in intuitive poise,
and he has dedicated his body and mind to the love of the Lord. ॥5॥
The One Lord dwells within the many and countless forms.
There are so many, countless religious rituals,
but without the fear of God and devotional worship, life is useless.
Singing the glorious praises of the Lord together, the supreme purpose of life is obtained. ॥6॥
He Himself dies, and He Himself kills.
He Himself creates, establishes and disestablishes.
You created the universe, O Lord of light, and all its kinds.
Contemplating the Word, one meets Him, and doubt is no more. ॥7॥
The superstition of impurity is a burning fire that consumes the world.
ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਥਾਇ ॥
Impurity is in the water, on the land, and everywhere.
O Nanak, caught in the superstition of impurity, people are born and die.
By the Guru's grace, drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ॥8॥4॥
One who reflects upon his own self appraises the jewel of the Name.
With a single glance of grace, the perfect Guru carries him across.
ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ; ਮਨ ਤੇ. ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੧॥
When the Guru is pleased, the mind is comforted within itself. ॥1॥
He is such a banker, and He makes such an appraisal,
ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ; ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that by His true glance of grace, one is carried across, attuned to the One Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One whose capital is the sublime Name of the Immaculate Lord
is pure; imbued with Truth, he becomes a true appraiser.
Through praise, he enshrines the Guru, the Creator, in the home of his heart, in intuitive poise. ॥2॥
One who burns away hope and desire through the Word,
chants the Name of the Lord, and inspires others to chant it;
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਵਾਟ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
through the Guru, he finds the path, the Mansion of the Lord's presence and his true home. ॥3॥
414: The Lord is pure like gold, and His light is incomparable;
He is the Divine Lord of the three worlds; all forms are His.
ਮੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ; ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੂਟੁ ॥੪॥
I have that wealth in my lap, true and inexhaustible. ॥4॥
He is pervading the five elements, the three qualities, the nine regions and the four directions.
He supports the earth and the sky by His power.
He turns back the outward-going mind. ॥5॥
One who is a fool does not see the Lord with his eyes.
His tongue does not taste the Name, and he does not understand what is said.
ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ; ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥੬॥
Intoxicated with the poison of Maya, he quarrels with the world. ॥6॥
In the sublime congregation, one becomes sublime.
He runs after virtue, and washes away his faults.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੭॥
Without serving the Guru, intuitive poise is not obtained. ॥7॥
The Name is a diamond, a jewel, a ruby.
ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
The mind as pure as a pearl has it as its wealth.
O Nanak, the Guru appraises us, and by His glance of grace we are enraptured. ॥8॥5॥
As Gurmukh, enshrine spiritual wisdom and meditation within your mind.
As Gurmukh, recognise the Mansion of the Lord's presence within.
As Gurmukh, keep the Word in your consciousness; this is your insignia. ॥1॥
In this way, through loving devotion, one becomes thoughtful.
The Gurmukh obtains the True Name of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Night and day, he keeps the Lord's pure, sublime dwelling within his heart.
He has true knowledge of the Lord, who pervades the three worlds and is free of desire.
From the True Guru, come to understand the Lord's Command. ॥2॥
His joy is true, and he has no sorrow.
He enjoys the ambrosial spiritual wisdom, the supreme sublime essence.
If the five passions are subdued, the whole world becomes happy. ॥3॥
Your light is in all, Lord; all are Yours.
He Himself unites, and separates again.
Whatever the Creator Himself does comes to pass. ॥4॥
He demolishes and builds again; by His Command, all merge back into Him.
His Command prevails as it pleases Him.
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਪੂਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
Without the Guru, no one obtains the Perfect Lord. ॥5॥
In childhood and in old age, his consciousness is not attuned to the Lord.
In the prime of youth, he is drowned in pride.
Without the Name, what shall he gain in the end? ॥6॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ; ਸਹਜਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
He does not know, in intuitive poise, the One whose food and wealth he enjoys.
Deluded by doubt, he regrets and repents in the end.
The noose is around the neck of the madman, and he wanders insane. ॥7॥
ਬੂਡਤ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਤਉ ਡਰਿ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
Seeing the world drowning, they run away in fear.
Very fortunate are they whom the True Guru has saved,
O Nanak, who are attached to the Guru's feet. ॥8॥6॥
They sing religious songs, but their consciousness is wicked.
They sing ragas, and call themselves free of love and hate,
but without the Name, their minds are false and wicked. ॥1॥
Where are you going, O mind? Stay in your own home.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ; ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Gurmukhs are satisfied with the Lord's Name; searching, you shall find the Lord with intuitive ease. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment fill the mind and body;
greed, avarice and ego bring only pain.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
Without the Lord's Name, how can the mind be comforted? ॥2॥
One who recognises the True Lord within bathes at the sacred shrine within.
The Gurmukh knows the condition of his inner being.
ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ; ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
Without the True Word, the Mansion of the Lord's presence is not recognised. ॥3॥
One who merges the world of form into the Formless Lord,
and enshrines within, through Truth, the True Lord whose power is beyond measure —
ਸੋ ਨਰੁ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
such a person does not enter the womb of reincarnation again. ॥4॥
Go there, where you can obtain the Name.
415: By the Guru's grace, may I do such deeds,
and, imbued with the Name, sing the glorious praises of the Lord. ॥5॥
Serving the Guru, one comes to understand one's own self.
Then the Ambrosial Name, the Giver of peace, comes to dwell in the mind.
Night and day, through the Bani, he remains imbued with the Name. ॥6॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਏ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
When my God attaches someone to Himself, then he is attached.
Conquering ego, he remains awake through the Word.
Here and hereafter, lasting peace is before him. ॥7॥
The fickle mind does not know the way.
The filthy self-willed manmukh does not recognise the Word.
The Gurmukh is pure, and chants the Name. ॥8॥
I offer my prayer to the Dear Lord,
that I may dwell in the company of the Holy;
ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
that my sins and sorrows may be cut away, and the Lord's Name may shine within me. ॥9॥
One who reflects and understands good conduct,
and comes to know the One Lord through the Words of the True Guru —
O Nanak, his mind is imbued with the Lord's Name. ॥10॥7॥
The mind of the faithless cynic is like a mad elephant.
It wanders through the forest of the world, distracted by attachment to Maya.
ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਾਹਿ; ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਚਾਪੇ ॥
Hounded by death, it goes here and there.
The Gurmukh searches, and finds his own true home. ॥1॥
Without the Word of the Guru, the mind finds no place of rest.
ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ. ਹਉਮੈ ਕਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remember in meditation the Lord's Name, which is most immaculate, and renounce the bitterness of ego. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹਸੀ ॥
Tell me, how can this foolish mind be held steady?
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝੇ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸੀ ॥
Without understanding, it shall suffer the pain of death.
The Lord Himself forgives us, and unites us with the True Guru.
Then the True Lord overcomes the torments of death, and urges us on. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
This mind performs its rituals, and this mind follows its religions.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ; ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤੇ ਜਨਮਾ ॥
This mind is born of the five elements.
The faithless, greedy mind is foolish.
The Gurmukh chants the Name, and his mind becomes beautiful. ॥3॥
The mind of the Gurmukh finds the Lord's place within.
The Gurmukh comes to understand the Lord who pervades the three worlds.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ; ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ. ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
This mind is a Yogi, an enjoyer of pleasures, a practitioner of penance.
The Gurmukh realises the Lord God Himself within. ॥4॥
This mind becomes detached, renouncing ego;
then again desire and duality afflict it in every heart.
The Gurmukh tastes the sublime essence of the Lord,
ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥੫॥
and at His door, in His Mansion, the Lord preserves his honour. ॥5॥
This mind is a king, a hero in battle.
Through the Name, as Gurmukh, this mind becomes fearless.
Conquering the five passions, it holds them under its control;
seizing its ego, it confines them all in one place. ॥6॥
The Gurmukh renounces attachment and all other pleasures.
As Gurmukh, this mind awakens to devotional worship.
Hearing the unstruck melody and contemplating the Word, it is pleased and appeased.
Understanding its own self, it becomes one with the Formless Lord. ॥7॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
This mind becomes pure, and sees the Lord within and without.
As Gurmukh, the melody of loving devotion resounds within.
Day and night, by the Guru's grace, it sings the Lord's praise.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ॥੮॥
That God, who was from the beginning and throughout the ages, is in each and every heart. ॥8॥
This mind is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord.
The Gurmukh comes to know the Source of all essences.
Dwelling at the Guru's feet, he loves devotional worship.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ; ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੯॥੮॥
O Nanak, he becomes the slave of the slaves of the Lord's humble servants. ॥9॥8॥
416: ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਧਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
When the body perishes, whose is the wealth?
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਕਤ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
Without the Guru, how can the Lord's Name be obtained?
The wealth of the Lord's Name is my companion and helper.
Night and day, one who is lovingly attuned to the Lord becomes pure. ॥1॥
Without the Lord's Name, who is ours?
ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ, ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I look upon pleasure and pain alike, and I shall not forsake the Name; the Lord Himself forgives me and unites me with Himself. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The fool loves gold and women.
Attached to duality, he has forgotten the Name.
One whom You forgive, Lord, You inspire to chant the Name.
ਦੂਤੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਕੈ; ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
Death cannot touch one who sings Your glorious praises. ॥2॥
The Lord, the Guru, is the Giver, the Lord, the Sustainer of the world.
As it pleases You, protect me, O merciful Lord.
As Gurmukh, the Lord has become pleasing to my mind.
My diseases are cured, and my pain is held in check. ॥3॥
ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਤੰਤ ਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
There is no other medicine, charm or mantra.
Remembering the Lord, Har, Har, in meditation destroys sins.
You Yourself lead us astray, making us forget the Name;
showering Your mercy, You Yourself save us. ॥4॥
The mind is sick with doubt, superstition and duality.
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਭਰਮਿ; ਜਪਹਿ ਜਪੁ. ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Without the Guru, it wanders in doubt, chanting the chants of duality.
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਰ; ਦਰਸ. ਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ॥
They do not behold the vision of the Guru, the Primal Lord;
without the Word of the Guru, what is the use of their lives? ॥5॥
Beholding the wonder of the Lord, I am wonderstruck.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ; ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
In each and every heart, of the angels and mortals, He dwells in deep poise.
You are fully pervading and supporting all, within every mind.
There is no other equal to You. ॥6॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ; ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Those who love devotional worship have the Name in their mouths;
the Lord dwells in the company of His Saints and devotees.
Breaking their bonds, they meditate in intuitive poise.
The Gurmukh is released, through the spiritual wisdom of the Lord, the Guru. ॥7॥
The messenger of death cannot cause any pain
ਜੋ ਜਨੁ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
to the humble being who remains awake, lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name.
The Lord, the Lover of devotion, dwells with His devotees.
O Nanak, they are liberated, imbued with the Lord's love. ॥8॥9॥
One who serves the Guru knows the Lord and Master.
His pain is erased, and he recognises the True Lord through the Word. ॥1॥
Meditate on the Lord, O my friends and companions.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ; ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Serving the True Guru, you shall behold God with your eyes. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Mother and father in this world are entanglements;
sons, daughters and spouse are entanglements. ॥2॥
Religious rituals performed in ego are entanglements.
When there is love of another in the mind, son and spouse are entanglements. ॥3॥
The farmers' farming is an entanglement.
ਹਉਮੈ ਡੰਨੁ ਸਹੈ; ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥
The king demands his taxes, and suffers the punishment of ego. ॥4॥
Trading without contemplation is an entanglement.
One is not satisfied, caught in the expanse of attachment to Maya. ॥5॥
The bankers' hoarding of wealth is an entanglement, for the wealth departs.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥੬॥
Without devotion to the Lord, nothing is accepted. ॥6॥
The Vedas, religious debates and egotism are entanglements.
Through the bonds of attachment and corruption, the mortal perishes. ॥7॥
Nanak seeks the sanctuary of the Lord's Name.
One who is saved by the True Guru is not bound by entanglements. ॥8॥10॥

those heads were shaved with scissors, and their throats were choked with dust.

ਉਪਰਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਾਰੀਐ; ਝਲੇ ਝਿਮਕਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥

Wealth and youthful beauty, which gave them such pleasure, have now become their enemies.

Make righteousness the soil, and plant the seed of truth; practise such farming.

Then you shall be known as a true trader, and you shall take your profit with you. ॥8॥

ਹਿਕੋ ਮੈਡਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ; ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You alone are my Lord; Your True Name is in my mouth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਿਧਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ. ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ; ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
Some serve the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, and the spiritual teachers, and beg for wealth and miraculous powers.
ਮੈ. ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੨॥
May I never forget the One Name; this is the wisdom of the True Guru. ॥2॥
419: ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀ; ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ॥
Why do the Yogis, the pleasure-seekers and the beggars wander in foreign lands?
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨੑਹੀ; ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ॥੩॥
They do not understand the Word of the Guru, or the sublime essence within them. ॥3॥
ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਜੋਇਸੀ; ਨਿਤ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
The Pandits, the religious teachers and the astrologers continually read the Puranas.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ; ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
They do not know what is within; God is hidden deep within them. ॥4॥
ਇਕਿ ਤਪਸੀ. ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਹਿ; ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Some penitents perform penance in the forests, and some dwell forever at sacred shrines.
ਆਪੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾਮਸੀ; ਕਾਹੇ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
Those dark souls do not understand themselves; why have they become renunciates? ॥5॥
ਇਕਿ. ਬਿੰਦੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਦੇ; ਸੇ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
Some make efforts to restrain their seed; they are called celibates.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ. ਨ ਛੂਟਹੀ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੬॥
But without the Guru's Word they are not saved, and they wander in reincarnation. ॥6॥
ਇਕਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Some are householders, servants and seekers, attached to the Guru's teaching.
ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੭॥
They hold fast to the Name, to charity, to cleansing and purification; they remain awake in devotion to the Lord. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
Through the Guru, the gate of the Lord's home is found; one who goes there recognises it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, he does not forget the Name; his mind is pleased with the True Lord. ॥8॥14॥
ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੇ; ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਚਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Merging the mind's desires into the mind itself, one crosses the terrifying world-ocean through the True Lord.
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
From the beginning and throughout the ages, You are merciful, O Lord and Master; I seek Your sanctuary. ॥1॥
ਤੂ ਦਾਤੌ. ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕਾ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
You are the Giver, and we are beggars; please bless us with the vision of Your Darshan, Lord.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name, and the temple of the mind shall be drenched with it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ; ਤਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Renouncing false greed, one comes to realise the True Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ; ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
Absorbed in the Word of the Guru, one comes to know the supreme purpose of life. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਲੋਭੀਆ; ਲੁਭਤਉ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥
This mind is a king, greedy, engrossed in greed.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
As Gurmukh, greed is eradicated, and one comes to an understanding with the Lord. ॥3॥
ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜੀਐ; ਕਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Planting seeds in barren soil, how can one obtain a profit?
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ. ਸਚਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ; ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਗਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
The self-willed manmukh is not pleased by Truth; falsehood is buried in falsehood. ॥4॥
ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਹੋ; ਲਾਲਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Renounce greed, O blind ones; greed brings only great pain.
ਸਾਚੌ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
When the True Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the poison of ego is overcome. ॥5॥
Renounce duality and the evil path, or you shall be plundered, O brothers.
Day and night, praise the Name, in the sanctuary of the True Guru. ॥6॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਹੈ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਫੀਕਾ ॥
The self-willed manmukh is a rock, a stone; his life is cursed and worthless.
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਰਾਖੀਐ; ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਕਾ ॥੭॥
No matter how long a stone is kept under water, it still remains dry within. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
The Name of the Lord is the treasure; the perfect Guru has given it to me.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
O Nanak, one who does not forget the Name churns out the Ambrosial Nectar and drinks it in. ॥8॥15॥
The travellers travel on, having lost their way.
ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ; ਸਚੁ. ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
The world is caught in its entanglements, and does not love the Truth. ॥1॥
ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ. ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੀਐ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Why wander and search around, when the Guru's Word has revealed Him?
ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਸਰਜਿਆ; ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Leaving behind possessiveness and attachment, one comes to dwell in one's own true home. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ; ਕੂੜਿ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Through Truth, the truthful one meets the Lord; He is not obtained through falsehood.
ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
Focusing your consciousness on the True Lord, you shall not have to come into the world again. ॥2॥
ਮੋਇਆ ਕਉ. ਕਿਆ ਰੋਵਹੁ; ਰੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ॥
Why do you weep for the dead? You do not know how to truly weep.
Weep while praising the True Lord, and recognise His Command. ॥3॥
Know that each one comes into the world with his allotted wages written by the Lord's Command.
Recognise His Command, and earn the profit for your lap. ॥4॥
420: By His Command, one departs robed in honour, and is pleasing in the Court of the Lord.
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ; ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥੫॥
By His Command, one is beaten over the head, and is cast into the Lord's prison. ॥5॥
Enshrine in your mind that the True Lord's justice prevails, and you shall earn the profit.
One receives what is written by one's own deeds; so shed your pride. ॥6॥
The self-willed are beaten over the head, and consumed by conflict.
The cheats are plundered by falsehood; they are chained and led away. ॥7॥
Enshrine the Lord and Master within your heart, and you shall not have to repent.
He forgives our sins, when we practise the Word. ॥8॥
Nanak begs for the True Name, which the Gurmukh labours to obtain.
ਮੈ. ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ; ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੯॥੧੬॥
I have no other than You, Lord; bless me with Your glance of grace. ॥9॥16॥
ਕਿਆ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਢੂਢੀ ਜਾਇ; ਮੈ. ਘਰਿ ਬਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ॥
Why should I go searching in the forests, when the forest is so green within my own home?
ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ; ਸਬਦਿ ਉਤਾਵਲਾ ॥੧॥
Through the Word, the True Lord quickly comes to dwell in the home of one who abides in Truth. ॥1॥
ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Wherever I look, there He is; I know no other.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ; ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Doing the Guru's work, one recognises the Mansion of the Lord's presence. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ; ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
When the True Lord unites one with Himself, He becomes pleasing to the mind.
One who walks forever in His Will merges into His Being. ॥2॥
ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
When the True Lord dwells in the mind, that mind sees Him dwelling everywhere.
ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਦੇ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
He Himself bestows glorious greatness; His gifts are never exhausted. ॥3॥
ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Serving this person and that, how can one obtain the Court of the Lord?
ਪਥਰ ਕੀ ਬੇੜੀ. ਜੇ ਚੜੈ; ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
If someone embarks on a boat of stone, he shall drown with its cargo. ॥4॥
ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ; ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Sell your mind to the Guru, and give your head along with it.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ; ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੫॥
Through the Guru, searching within your own home, the real thing is recognised. ॥5॥
ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
People speak of birth and death; the Creator made this.
ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ. ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੬॥
Those who shed their self-conceit and remain dead to the self shall never die again. ॥6॥
ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ; ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
Do the deeds the Primal Lord has ordained for you.
ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਕਿਨਿ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
If one surrenders the mind and meets the True Guru, who can estimate his worth? ॥7॥
ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ; ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
That Lord is the assayer of jewels; He places the value on them.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
O Nanak, when the Lord and Master dwells in the mind, true glorious greatness is obtained. ॥8॥17॥
ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
Those who have forgotten the Name are deluded by doubt and duality.
ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਡਾਲੀ ਲਗੇ; ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
Those who abandon the root and cling to the branches obtain only ashes. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Without the Name, how can one be released? Let anyone who knows this understand.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ. ਤ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who becomes Gurmukh is released; the self-willed manmukh loses his honour. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Those who serve the One Lord have perfect understanding, O brothers.
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ; ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
The Lord's humble servants seek the sanctuary of the Immaculate Lord, who is from the beginning and throughout the ages. ॥2॥
ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
My Lord and Master is the One; there is no other, O brothers.
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ, ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾਚੇ ਪਰਥਾਈ ॥੩॥
By His grace, one finds peace, in the support of the True Lord. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ, ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਕੇਤੀ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Without the Guru, no one has obtained Him, though many may claim it.
ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਵਾਟੜੀਂ; ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੪॥
He Himself reveals the path, and implants true devotional worship within. ॥4॥
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ; ਭੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
Even if the self-willed manmukh is taught, he still goes into the wilderness.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ. ਨ ਛੂਟਸੀ; ਮਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
Without the Lord's Name, he shall not be released; he shall die, and sink into hell. ॥5॥
ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
He wanders through birth and death, and does not chant the Lord's Name.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ॥੬॥
He does not know the Name's worth, without serving the Guru. ॥6॥
